text: Usefulness is measured by running through the scenario with GPT-4 implementing the untrusted model and measuring the proportion of submitted code that is correct, that is, passes all the test cases. Safety is estimated by having the red team replace the untrusted models with an attack policy, implemented as a pipeline using GPT-4 with the goal of causing the protocol to insert backdoors, then running through the scenario and measuring the probability that the protocol submits backdoored code at least once during the sequence of problems.
title: Separate usefulness and safety measurements
